original_test_intent: Verify every expected CPU0 through CPUN package-power sensor is correctly identified and its watt reading, status and configured thresholds are human-readable and match the approved BMC/CPU sensor specification.
original_method: Enumerate all expected CPU package-power channels and immutable raw/UI identities, collect complete watt/unit/status/threshold metadata with synchronized CPU load/frequency/temperature context, capture WebUI rows and compare each channel to the owner specification under defined scale, sampling and rounding rules.
manual_activity: The owner provides CPU topology, package-power mapping, watts/threshold/sampling contract and context tolerances; an operator verifies WebUI readability/correlation and adjudicates anomalies.
required_inputs: CPU socket to SDR/Redfish/UI package-power mapping
Watt unit/scale/threshold and sensor sampling/averaging contract
Read-only CPU load/frequency/temperature and optional approved independent package-power reference
UI refresh/rounding tolerance, protected access and evidence/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep access read-only; never change power caps, governors, thresholds, workload or thermal policy
Use protected authentication and complete non-truncated enumeration
Bind each sample to CPU socket identity and synchronized operating context
Preserve logs and stop/escalate on negative, stale or implausible watts, alarm, missing/duplicate mapping or health fault
Do not refresh or alter load until a mismatch disappears
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate and verify the full CPU package-power population and socket mappings
Collect complete raw values, units, status, thresholds, identities and timestamps plus read-only context
Assist with synchronized WebUI capture and approved unit/rounding normalization
Report per-socket missing, extra, mismatch, stale or alarm conditions for owner verdict
Perform no power-policy mutation or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Supply CPU mapping, package-power specification and sampling/context tolerances

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH PACKAGE-GATED CPU PACKAGE-POWER POPULATION VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a per-socket matrix of physical CPU identity, raw watts/unit/status/threshold, sample timestamp/context and UI display, with missing/extra/duplicate and specification comparison results.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact socket mapping and dynamic operating context while replacing insecure/truncated generic reads and log clearing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One instantaneous value or screenshot cannot cover CPU0..N or prove package-power semantics. Every expected socket, threshold and UI/raw mapping is required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Package power is dynamic and implementation-specific; BMC and host references can use different windows, domains or scaling, so only an approved timing and normalization contract supports comparison.

project_override_considerations: If the platform exposes package power only for populated sockets or an aggregate domain, the owner must define the authoritative expected population and mapping without borrowing the separate power-cap row.

Per-socket package-power channel to raw/UI identity matrix
Complete raw watts/unit/status/threshold/entity/timestamp plus synchronized load/frequency/temperature context
WebUI screenshots and approved sampling/rounding/reference comparison
Per-socket differences, no-write/no-log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently target CPU package-power readings and thresholds. Exact socket mapping and dynamic interpretation are required project inputs rather than contradictory source requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Mapping, specification, UI and context inputs gate execution while static review remains complete.

review_improvement: Defines complete per-socket package-power coverage with time-aligned context and raw/UI correlation instead of treating a wildcard-like sensor read as proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: Package-power values cannot be judged in isolation because workload, frequency, thermals and averaging window change the measurement. A plausible watt number may still belong to the wrong socket or represent a different power domain. Therefore identity, timestamped context and the owner scale/sampling contract are required before comparing raw and UI readings. The adjacent power-cap setting is a limit, not a substitute measurement or expected instantaneous value.
